    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The LL.B (3-year) Programme is a postgraduate professional law degree designed for graduates seeking to pursue a career in law after graduation. Conducted over six semesters, the programme provides a structured foundation in substantive and procedural law.								
				
				
				
									The curriculum emphasises constitutional, criminal, civil and commercial law while fostering analytical engagement and professional responsibility. Academic study is supported by practical components including moot courts, internships, legal aid initiatives, court visits and drafting exercises, ensuring meaningful exposure to the practice of law.								
				
				
				
									Graduates of the programme are eligible to enrol as advocates in accordance with applicable regulatory norms and may pursue careers in litigation, judiciary, corporate practice and related legal fields.

					Programme Outcomes				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					01To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.
				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy and ethical conduct.

					Teaching Methodology				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									The teaching methodology at RVILS combines rigorous doctrinal study with structured practical exposure, preparing students to apply legal principles in real-world situations with clarity and confidence.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
    
          
        
      
      
        
    Interactive Classroom Teaching    
    
          
      
        
          
          
        
      
        
  
  
  
     
    
          		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
				
				
									Classroom learning is rigorous and participative. Faculty members use case-law analysis, statutory interpretation, structured discussions, debates, problem-based learning and moot simulations to build critical reasoning and advocacy skills. Emphasis is placed on constitutional values and the application of law to contemporary issues.

									To bridge theory and practical knowledge, organised visits are conducted to courts, tribunals, prisons, police stations, forensic laboratories, legislative bodies and legal aid centres. These engagements provide first-hand insight into the functioning of the justice delivery system and deepen understanding of procedural and institutional processes.

    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The B.A. LL.B (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with humanities and social sciences, offering a structured pathway for students seeking to pursue careers in litigation, judiciary, civil services and public law.The integrated curriculum provides grounding in constitutional and criminal law while fostering critical engagement with questions of governance, rights and social justice. This academic learning is supported by moot courts, internships and legal aid activities, ensuring practical exposure alongside doctrinal study.Graduates of the programme are prepared for professional practice, judicial services examinations, civil services, academia and related roles within the legal profession.

									Classroom learning is rigorous and participative. Faculty members use case-law analysis, statutory interpretation, structured discussions, debates, problem-based learning and moot simulations to build critical reasoning and advocacy skills. Emphasis is placed on constitutional values and the application of law to contemporary issues.

    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The B.B.A. LL.B. (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with business and management studies, providing a structured pathway for students seeking careers in corporate and commercial law.The integrated curriculum offers grounding in core legal principles alongside an understanding of corporate governance, compliance and commercial regulation. Practical exposure through internships with law firms, corporate entities and legal departments ensures that academic learning is complemented by professional experience.Graduates of the programme are prepared to pursue professional roles in corporate advisory, commercial litigation, compliance and related areas of legal practice.

					Programme Outcomes				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					01It develops legal professionals with a strong understanding of business practices and corporate legal skills, making them valuable in legal departments of corporations or law firms specialising in business law.  				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy, and ethical conduct.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To expose students to International and Comparative Law, promoting a global perspective and understanding to legal systems beyond their jurisdiction. 				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To offer opportunities for students to specialise in specific areas of law, enabling them to develop expertise in fields such as Environmental Law, Intellectual Property, Human Rights or Corporate Law.
				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Programme Objectives				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									




  
    PO1
    
      Combines legal studies with a specific focus on business administration, providing a strong foundation in Business Principles, Management and Corporate law.
    
  

  
    PO2
    
      Emphasises an understanding of the legal implications of business decisions, preparing students for roles where legal expertise intersects with corporate strategy.
    
  

  
    PO3
    
      Displays comprehension and expertise in Substantive law, Procedural law and Constitutional law.
    
  

  
    PO4
    
      Builds proficiency in conducting legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem-solving, written and oral communication in the legal context and applying it in legal practice and real-life situations.
    
  

  
    PO5
    
      Exhibits the professional skills essential for legal practice, including pleading, argument, drafting, conveyancing, collaboration, counselling and negotiation.
    
  

  
    PO6
    
      Enhances the ability to analyse legal aspects in connection with contemporary developments at National and International levels.
    
  

  
    PO7
    
      Demonstrates a thorough understanding of professional ethics and regulations, and showcases their practical application in the legal profession.

					Academic Qualification				
				
				
				
									Candidates seeking admission to the 5-year B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Programme must have completed a Pre-University Course or Senior Secondary School Examination (10+2 pattern) from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government in India.Applicants who have completed an equivalent qualification from a foreign institution recognised by the government of that country and recognised in India are also eligible to apply.Admission shall be granted in accordance with the regulations of Karnataka State Law University, Hubballi.Foreign NationalsForeign Nationals seeking admission are eligible, subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions. The Admission Committee shall determine the equivalence of the qualifying examination for admission.

    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The B.Com. LL.B. (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with the study of commerce and finance, enabling students to understand the interface between law, business and financial systems.In addition to core areas of law, the curriculum incorporates subjects that provide grounding in accounting, taxation, corporate finance and economic regulation. This integrated structure supports engagement with legal issues relating to corporate governance, banking, insurance, securities regulation and fiscal compliance.The programme includes practical components such as internships with law firms, corporate entities and financial institutions, ensuring exposure to professional environments alongside academic study. Graduates are equipped to pursue professional pathways in corporate advisory, taxation practice, financial compliance and related commercial sectors.

					Programme Objectives				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					01To impart foundational and advanced knowledge in commerce and legal studies.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To cultivate analytical and critical thinking skills applicable to legal and commercial challenges.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy and ethical conduct. 
				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To expose students to International and Comparative law, promoting a global perspective and understanding of legal systems beyond their jurisdiction. 				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To offer opportunities for students to specialise in specific areas of Law, enabling them to develop expertise in fields such as Environmental Law, Intellectual Property, Human Rights or Corporate Law.
				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Programme Outcomes				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									

  
    PO1
    Acquire the essential knowledge on the successful prospects of business.
  

  
    PO2
    Understand the practical issues and challenges that the trade world encounters.
  

  
    PO3
    Display comprehension and expertise in Substantive Law, Procedural Law and Constitutional Law.
  

  
    PO4
    Build proficiency in conducting legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem-solving, written and oral communication in the legal context, and apply it in legal practice and real-life situations.
  

  
    PO5
    Exhibit the professional skills essential for legal practice, including pleading, augment, drafting, conveyancing, collaboration, counselling and negotiation.
  

  
    PO6
    Enhance the skill to analyse legal aspects in connection with contemporary developments at National and International levels.

					Academic Qualification				
				
				
				
									Candidates seeking admission to the 5-year B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Programme must have completed a Pre-University Course or Senior Secondary School Examination (10+2 pattern) from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government in India.Applicants who have completed an equivalent qualification from a foreign institution recognised by the government of that country and recognised in India are also eligible to apply.Admission shall be granted in accordance with the regulations of Karnataka State Law University, Hubballi.Foreign NationalsForeign Nationals seeking admission are eligible, subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions. The Admission Committee shall determine the equivalence of the qualifying examination for admission.

					Teaching Methodology				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									The teaching methodology at RVILS combines rigorous doctrinal study with structured practical exposure, preparing students to apply legal principles in real-world situations with clarity and confidence.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
    
          
        
      
      
        
    Interactive Classroom Teaching    
    
          
      
        
          
          
        
      
        
  
  
  
     
    
          		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
				
				
									Classroom learning is rigorous and participative. Faculty members use case-law analysis, statutory interpretation, structured discussions, debates, problem-based learning and moot simulations to build critical reasoning and advocacy skills. Emphasis is placed on constitutional values and the application of law to contemporary issues.								
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
		
     
    
  




  
    
          
        
      
      
        
    Field Visits    
    
          
      
        
          
          
        
      
        
  
  
  
     
    
          		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
				
				
									To bridge theory and practical knowledge, organised visits are conducted to courts, tribunals, prisons, police stations, forensic laboratories, legislative bodies and legal aid centres. These engagements provide first-hand insight into the functioning of the justice delivery system and deepen understanding of procedural and institutional processes.

					ABOUT college				
				
					
		
					
		
				
				
																														
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									Established in 2018 by the RV Educational Institutions (RVEI), MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) was founded in response to the growing complexity of disputes, rising crime and emerging challenges such as cybercrime within an evolving legal landscape. Situated in Bengaluru, a leading centre for professional education, the Institute was conceived with a distinct and contemporary approach to legal training.Renamed in honour of Dr. M.K. Panduranga Setty, President Emeritus of RSST, the institution reflects a legacy of service and academic responsibility. RVILS is affiliated with Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) and approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI).The Institute offers the B.A., LL.B., B.B.A., LL.B. and B.Com., LL.B. 5-year integrated programmes, along with the 3-year LL.B. programme. It is committed to producing competent legal professionals capable of contributing meaningfully to the courts, the profession and society at large.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					About RVEI 				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Late Sri M.C. Sivananda
Sharma				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Founder Secretary
Rashtreeya Sikahana Samithi Trust				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									RV Educational Institutions (RVEI) was founded in 1940 by the late Sri M.C. Sivananda Sarma, on a conviction that education is not a privilege, but a right. What began as a single school has, over eight decades, grown into a network of 28+ institutions serving more than 24,000 students and supported by over 3,000 staff members. The academic framework spans kindergarten to postgraduate education across technology, health sciences, management, humanities, natural sciences, social sciences and legal studies.RVEI has always believed that a well-rounded institution must serve a wide cross-section of society. That includes education for students with special needs and sustained outreach to the less privileged. Rural health camps and community awareness programmes reflect this commitment and further underscore that the institution’s responsibility does not end at its gates.Its enduring motto, “Go, change the world”, is the standard RVEI has held itself to for over eight decades.

					Vision				
				
				
				
																														
				
				
				
									Imparting legal education to create globally competent and socially relevant professionals.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
		
						
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
		
						
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Mission				
				
				
				
																														
				
				
				
							
							
											
													
										 To imbue students with professional ethics along with honing skills.
									
								
											
													
										To enable students to become the exponents of justice for common man.
									
								
											
													
										To provide appropriate academic ambience backed with intellectual and technical logistics to groom students for the profession. 
									
						
						
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Goal				
				
				
				
																														
				
				
				
							
							
											
													
										To ensure that students get the best legal education and optimum knowledge of legal skills.
									
								
											
													
										To inculcate values and pro bono commitment in students by involving them in legal aid programmes.

     Alumni Testimonials 
  

				
				
				
				
									Hear from the graduates of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) their journeys, transformations and reflections on five years of legal education, friendships and growth.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    2020-2025 Batch

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					

		
		
		



  
  
  	
      
	


	


	


	


	


	


    
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   
    
                
	  
                  
	        
          
          
                          
		
		  		  		
        
	        
              
                    
      	        
                    
	   		
    

  
    

  
    

  
    

  
    


				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					

		




  
    






  
  
  
      

              
                                    Aryan Shetty
                      
          B.B.A. LL.B.“Looking back, RVILS gave me more than just a legal education. It gave me clarity, confidence, and community. What truly sets this college apart is its culture, from moot courts and scholarly discussions on contemporary legal topics with visiting scholars to the unwavering commitment of the faculty. The environment here constantly pushed me to grow, not just as a law student, but as a confident individual ready to face anything in the legal world. Every corner of this campus holds a lesson, a memory, or a mentor who shaped my journey. It’s here that I found my voice, learned to think fearlessly, and realised that law is a powerful tool to create meaningful change."                    
        
          
        
      
      
      
  
  
      

              
                                    Taskeen Shaikh
                      
          B.A.LLB.“I joined MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies in 2020 as a B.A., LL.B. student, and looking back, it’s been an amazing journey. When I first started, I was very shy and unsure of myself. But over the years, I slowly came out of my shell. I got involved in various activities, participated in moots, and even won a few competitions, which really boosted my confidence. The atmosphere at college always pushed me to do better and explore my potential beyond academics. What made my experience even better were the people around me. I made some great friends who stood by me through everything, and my teachers were always supportive and encouraging. They guided me not just in academics but throughout the entire course of my legal education. Today, I feel much more confident and outgoing than I was when I first walked into the campus. I’m grateful for the experiences and lessons over these five years, which have shaped my growth in the law field. ”                   
        
          
        
      
      
      
  
  
      

              
                                    Harsha M.Talur
                      
          B.B.A. LL.B.“Life is like a roller coaster; it is full of surprises, ups and downs, and twists and turns. However, life is great when it goes well. Our time in college is equally thrilling, with ups and downs akin to those on a roller coaster. College is a truly amazing and unexpected time in life when we make adult decisions about our future, make a lot of friends, decide on our majors, decide on our careers, and get ready for the challenges of the real world. My time at RV was an exciting and fulfilling one, the institute provided me with every opportunity to know and achieve my potential. It shaped me through to participate in numerous competitions, to give my best and win them. The infrastructure like library, digital library and other facilities has helped me to navigate throughout this journey. Additionally there are various committees in the college that helped me get involved in activities of my interests. ”                   
        
          
        
      
      
      
  
  
      

              
                                    Ayushi Vyas
                      
           B.B.A. LL.B."My college has been a world in itself – vibrant, nurturing, and transformative. It has not only shaped my academic journey but also uplifted me as an individual. With unwavering support from faculty and a community that fosters growth, it has been a place where dreams take root and futures are built. I will always carry its spirit with pride and gratitude. "                   
        
          
        
      
      
      
  
  
      

              
                                    Anirudh Ramesh P
                      
          B.A. LL.B.“My time at MKPM RVILS has been nothing short of transformative. Beyond academic excellence, it has been a space for personal evolution, shaping my character, sharpening my skills, and instilling in me the confidence to take on the world. 					MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies Celebrates 8th Foundation Day and Hosts 2nd Alumni Meet with a Spectacular Musical Evening				
				
				
				
					Date: 30 June, 2026				
				
				
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies successfully celebrated its 8th Foundation Day along with the 2nd Alumni Meeton 30th June 2026 at the Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS Campus. The event brought together alumni, faculty members, students, and staff in a joyous celebration of the institution’s remarkable journey, achievements, and enduring legacy.The programme served as a platform to reconnect with alumni, strengthen institutional bonds, and celebrate the growth and accomplishments of the MKPM RVILS family over the past eight years. Alumni from different graduating batches reminisced about their memorable experiences at the institution, shared their professional journeys, and inspired the current students with their success stories.Adding vibrancy to the celebrations, the evening featured an enthralling live musical performance by the VORTEX Band, whose energetic and captivating performance created a lively atmosphere. The band’s dynamic repertoire of music entertained the audience and made the Foundation Day and Alumni Meet a memorable occasion filled with enthusiasm, nostalgia, and celebration.The event reflected the institution’s commitment to fostering lifelong relationships with its alumni while celebrating the spirit of excellence, unity, and community that defines MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.The management, faculty, staff, students, and alumni collectively commemorated this significant milestone, reaffirming their shared vision of academic excellence and professional integrity.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Orientation Session for the 36th YMCA Model Parliament Competition				
				
				
				
					Date: 01 sep, 2025				
				
				
				
									An orientation session for the 36th YMCA Model Parliament Competition was conducted on 1st September, 2025, and led by RVILS alumnus Mr. Chinmayee.The session introduced students of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) to the structure and procedures of the Model Parliament, offering insights into parliamentary functioning and legislative processes. Drawing from his experience, Mr. Chinmayee guided students on debating techniques, drafting motions and maintaining parliamentary decorum during parliamentary proceedings.The interactive session provided students with a practical understanding of the competition and encouraged participation in Model Parliament and legislative simulation activities.

    Built for the  Practice of Law
  

				
				
				
				
																														
				
				
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) offers a well-equipped campus environment designed to support academic learning, legal research and student development. Whether it is technology-enabled classrooms and dedicated legal research facilities or sports infrastructure and student amenities, the campus provides the resources required for a comprehensive law school experience in Bengaluru.

    Moot Court Hall

					Inauguration of 1st Semester Classes and Orientation Programme 2026-27				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
							
			
											
					
						
				
				
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies conducted the Inauguration of the 1st Semester classes and Orientation Programme 2026- 27 for the Students for the B.A., LL.B., B.B.A., LL.B., B.Com., LL.B., 5 Year Integrated Degree Courses and 3-Year LL.B. on 6th September, 2026 at 11:00 AM at Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS. The Chief Guest of the day was Hon’ble Shri Justice Venkatesh Naik T, Judge, High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru. The Guest of Honour for the day was Dr. Manju Naik B T, Associate Professor, Government Law College, Ramanagara and Sri.N.R.  Nandish, Chairman, governing Council, MKPM RVILS & Trustee, Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust and the programme was presided over by Dr. M P Shyam, President,  Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust and Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K. R., Principal of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies, delivered a heartfelt welcome address where he welcomed the dignitaries and the 9th Batch of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.Hon’ble Justice Venkatesh Naik T, addressing MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies –  urged students to practise law with empathy, honesty and integrity. Sir emphasised that a law degree alone is not enough and advised students to develop strong research, communication, negotiation and critical-thinking skills. Followed by the curtain raiser for the 5th Edition of Samarthana Magazine of the college.The Guest of Honour, Dr. Manju Naik B T, speaking at the MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studiesorientation urged students to participate in moot courts and study classic law books to strengthen their practical and legal knowledge. Delivering the presidential address, Dr. M.P. Shyam said students were entering not merely a degree programme but a profession that touches every facet of life, carrying the hopes and trust of their families. He urged students to go beyond marks through debates, seminars, moot courts and wide reading, while developing clear thinking, conviction, honesty and character, and carrying a strong sense of purpose to serve society.

					4th Graduation Ceremony (2021–2026 Batch).				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
						
				
				
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies proudly celebrated its 4th Graduation Ceremony for the 2021–2026 Batch on 4th July 2026 at the Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS Campus, marking a significant milestone in the academic journey of its graduating students.The ceremony was graced by Hon’ble Sri Justice Vibhu Bakhru, Chief Justice, High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru, as the Chief Guest, whose inspiring address encouraged the graduates to uphold the values of justice, integrity, and professional excellence while serving society. The event was presided over by Dr. M. P. Shyam, President, Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust, Bengaluru, who congratulated the graduating students and motivated them to embrace the legal profession with commitment and responsibility.The programme commenced with the State Anthem, followed by the Invocation Song and Welcome Address. A special presentation titled “Journey of Graduands” highlighted the academic achievements and memorable experiences of the graduating batch. The graduates then took the Oath, reaffirming their commitment to the ethical practice of law. The ceremony also featured the Presentation of Mementoes, the Presidential Address, Vote of Thanks, and concluded with the National Anthem and Group Photographs, creating cherished memories for the graduates, their families, and the institution.The Graduation Ceremony reflected the institution’s unwavering commitment to academic excellence, professional ethics, and holistic legal education. As the graduates embark on the next chapter of their professional journey, MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies extends its heartfelt congratulations and wishes them continued success in all their future endeavours.

					 8th Foundation Day and Hosts 2nd Alumni Meet with a Spectacular Musical Evening				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
						
				
				
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies successfully celebrated its 8th Foundation Day along with the 2nd Alumni Meeton 30th June 2026 at the Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS Campus. The event brought together alumni, faculty members, students, and staff in a joyous celebration of the institution’s remarkable journey, achievements, and enduring legacy.The programme served as a platform to reconnect with alumni, strengthen institutional bonds, and celebrate the growth and accomplishments of the MKPM RVILS family over the past eight years. Alumni from different graduating batches reminisced about their memorable experiences at the institution, shared their professional journeys, and inspired the current students with their success stories.Adding vibrancy to the celebrations, the evening featured an enthralling live musical performance by the VORTEX Band, whose energetic and captivating performance created a lively atmosphere. The band’s dynamic repertoire of music entertained the audience and made the Foundation Day and Alumni Meet a memorable occasion filled with enthusiasm, nostalgia, and celebration.The event reflected the institution’s commitment to fostering lifelong relationships with its alumni while celebrating the spirit of excellence, unity, and community that defines MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.The management, faculty, staff, students, and alumni collectively commemorated this significant milestone, reaffirming their shared vision of academic excellence and professional integrity.

					State-Level Programme on World No Tobacco Day				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
						
				
				
				
									The MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies, in collaboration with the Department of Health and Family Welfare, successfully organised a State-Level Programme in view of World No Tobacco Day on 11 June 2026 at the Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS Campus, Bengaluru. The programme was conducted under the theme “Unmasking the Appeal – Countering Nicotine and Tobacco Addiction” with the objective of creating awareness among students and the public about the harmful effects of tobacco consumption and promoting a tobacco-free generation.The programme was inaugurated by Dr. Rajani M. in the presence of distinguished dignitaries including Dr. K. G. Suresh, CA Dr. A. S. Vishnu Bharath, Dr. Rajani P. and Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K. R. welcomed the gathering and emphasised the importance of collective efforts in combating tobacco addiction among youth.The programme featured addresses by senior officials from the Department of Health and Family Welfare and the Directorate of Municipal Administration, including Mr. Ravindra P. N. and Mrs. M. V. Thusharamani, who highlighted the importance of effective implementation of tobacco control measures and public awareness initiatives.A significant highlight of the event was the launch of the Three-Month Tobacco-Free Educational Institution Guidelines Implementation Project and the release of tobacco-control related guidelines aimed at strengthening tobacco-free educational environments across institutions. Students of MKPM RVILS also took a pledge to support and promote a tobacco-free society.The programme further included an engaging panel discussion on the effective enforcement of tobacco control laws to create a tobacco-free generation and a powerful mime performance by the students of MKPM RVILS depicting the ill effects of tobacco consumption. The event served as a meaningful platform for dialogue, awareness and collective action towards building a healthier and tobacco-free future.

    Legal Services  Clinic
  

				
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) provides students with practical exposure to legal aid and community outreach activities. Under the guidance of faculty members, students participate in initiatives such as legal awareness programmes, legal aid camps, socio-legal surveys and educational visits to courts and legal institutions.The Clinic also collaborates with organisations such as the District Legal Services Authority to conduct programmes that promote legal awareness among the public. These activities help students understand how law operates in real social contexts while encouraging a sense of professional responsibility towards access to justice.								
				
				
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                    
                    Visit Legal Services Clinic 

                                                                                
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					



  
    Aim, Mission  & Objectives
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Aim				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									To provide legal aid through human resource, knowledge resource & infrastructural resource to those who need it the most, purely on a pro- bono basis.								
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Mission				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic operates in line with the institutional commitment of RVILS towards social responsibility. It seeks to foster sensitivity to community issues, encourage meaningful engagement with society, and promote ethical, value-based legal education through practice and outreach.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Objectives				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
							
											
													
										To promote legal awareness and literacy within the community
									
								
											
													
										To organise legal aid and literacy programmes in collaboration with relevant authorities
									
								
											
													
										To provide free legal assistance to socially and economically disadvantaged sections
									
								
											
													
										To facilitate access to the justice system for those facing practical or financial barriers
									
						
						
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
							
							
											
													
										To develop practical legal skills and professional competence among students
									
								
											
													
										To support initiatives relating to legal policy and institutional frameworks in association with statutory bodies
									
								
											
													
										To encourage a sense of responsibility towards legal and social issues
									
						
						
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Services Provided by the Legal Services Clinic				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Legal Literacy Programmes - Organisation of camps and awareness programmes in association with bodies such as DLSA, KLSA and NALSA, including outreach in villages, institutions and community spaces.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Legal Advice - Free legal consultation available on working days (Monday to Friday: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM – 1:30 PM.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Para-Legal Services - Assistance with drafting applications, documentation, and guidance on procedures relating to government services and legal forums.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Dispute Resolution - Facilitation of amicable settlement through mediation by faculty members, practising advocates and participation in Lok Adalats.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Training and Capacity Building - Organisation of seminars, workshops and training programmes to provide practical exposure to student members.

                     25th September 2026

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Essay Writing Competition				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									On 25th September 2026, the Legal Services Clinic of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies organized an intra-collegiate Essay Writing Competition in observance of Social Justice Day to foster critical awareness of constitutional rights, systemic inequities, and access to justice. The initiative provided a dynamic academic platform for undergraduate law students to articulate well-researched perspectives on grassroots legal aid, marginalized community empowerment, and judicial reforms. Evaluating entries on analytical rigor, originality, and statutory understanding, the event successfully reinforced the social responsibility inherent in legal education, inspiring future advocates to actively champion equity and pro bono service.

                    11th November, 2025

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					The Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Assault and Other Crimes				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									This special lecture was held on the occasion of National Legal Services Day, in association with the District Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru Urban.Adv. Vanishree R addressed students on the legal remedies, compensation mechanisms and institutional support available to victims and survivors of sexual offences. The session aimed to raise awareness of victim-centric legal provisions and strengthen students’ understanding of access to justice.The event was attended by Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K.R., Principal, RVILS. The programme was coordinated by Prof. (Dr.) Hanuma Prakash K.S., Legal Services Clinic Coordinator.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    19th August, 2025

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Pick and Speak Competition on World Humanitarian Day

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The programme was inaugurated by our Principal, who addressed students on the significance of World Humanitarian Day and encouraged participation in activities that promote awareness, communication skills and social responsibility. The competition witnessed the participation of 22 students from various semesters. Participants picked topics randomly and delivered short speeches, demonstrating critical thinking and public speaking abilities.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    11th July, 2025

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Misuse, Illegal and Unauthorised Display of Symbols, Seals, Flags, Emblem and Name of the State Emblem of India

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The programme was organised in association with the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority and the District Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru Urban District. The session addressed the misuse and unauthorised display of National symbols, seals, flags and The State Emblem of India.The programme discussed the provisions of The State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005. Mr. Aswin K., Assistant Professor, RVILS, explained the legal framework governing the use of national emblems and symbols.Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K.R., Principal, RVILS, highlighted the objectives of the legislation and spoke about the significance of the National motto “Satyameva Jayate”, emphasising the importance of responsible and lawful use of national symbols in public and private contexts.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    8th April, 2025

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					 Legal Awareness Programme at Tharalu Grama Panchayat

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The programme was organised to educate villagers about their legal rights and important welfare legislation.Awareness was created on the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007, and the Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prohibition of Transfer of Certain Lands) Act, 1978, highlighting protections available to senior citizens and members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.The programme was attended by Sri Bhola Pandit (Senior Civil Judge and Member Secretary, DLSA Bengaluru Rural) as Chief Guest and Sri. Shanmukha (Member, Tharalu Grama Panchayat) as Guest of Honour. The event was presided over by our Principal.

                    12th November, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					 Observance of World Mental Health Day				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									A programme was organised in observance of World Mental Health Day 2024 in collaboration with TELE MANAS, NIMHANS.The session focused on promoting awareness about mental health and its significance in personal and professional life.The speakers engaged students through interactive discussions and activities, highlighting the importance of mental health awareness, early support mechanisms and responsible social engagement.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    9th November, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					National Legal Services Day Observance

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic and National Service Scheme (NSS) Unit observed National Legal Services Day on 9th November, 2024.The programme featured Shri Shridhar Prabhu (Advocate, Triguna Icon, Bengaluru) as the Chief Guest, who delivered a talk on “Law Students as Vanguards of Legal Services”. In his address, he emphasised the importance of legal services in ensuring access to justice and highlighted the role of law students in promoting legal awareness within society.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    14th November, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Observance of Children’s Day

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									RVILS observed Children’s Day on 14th November, 2024, at Sri S. Janardhan Government Kannada Higher Primary School, Gurupanna Palya, Bengaluru, as part of its community outreach activities.The programme was organised by the National Service Scheme (NSS) Unit and presided over by Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K.R., Principal, RVILS.Students of the school were presented with gifts including stationery sets, geometry boxes and sweets. RVILS students also interacted with the children through games and engaging activities, creating an enjoyable and meaningful celebration.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    23rd October, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Awareness Rally on International Day of the Girl Child 


				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic in association with the District Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru Urban, organised an awareness rally (jatha) at Gandhi Bazar, Bengaluru.The rally was led by 55 student volunteers raising awareness about the importance of protecting and valuing the girl child. Students raised slogans and interacted with members of the public to promote respect, rights and opportunities for girls in society.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    5th October, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Visit to Amruthavani Vridh Seva Trust – Senior Citizens’ Day

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The students visited Amruthavani Vridh Seva Trust, Banashankari, Bengaluru, in observance of Senior Citizens’ Day 2024.Final-year student coordinators and volunteers of the clinic interacted with the residents of the home and spent time with them, creating an opportunity for meaningful engagement and social outreach.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    5th June, 2024

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					World Environment Day – 2024

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The institution observed World Environment Day 2024 at Mangala Mantapa, MKPM RVILS.In association with:Karnataka State Legal Services AuthorityHigh Court Legal Services AuthorityDistrict Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru UrbanAdvocates’ Association, BengaluruThe programme was inaugurated by Hon’ble Shri Justice K. Somashekar, Judge, High Court of Karnataka.Guests of Honour:Shri Vivek Subba Reddy (President, Advocates’ Association, Bengaluru).Shri M. L. Raghunath (District Judge & Member Secretary, Karnataka State Legal Services Authority).Shri Muralidhara Pai B. (Principal City Civil & Sessions Judge & Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Bengaluru Urban).The programme was presided over by Dr M.P. Shyam, President, RVEI, in the presence of our principal.As part of the observance, saplings were planted on the campus to promote environmental awareness and sustainability.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
		          
      


            	   
    2023
  
    
      
      
    
  
  
    		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Educational Visit to Lok Adalat				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									Students of the VIII Semester B.A. LL.B. and B.B.A. LL.B. programmes visited the Lok Adalat, Bengaluru, where they gained firsthand exposure to alternative dispute resolution and the settlement of disputes through conciliation.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Educational Visit to Central Jail 
				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									Students of the X Semester B.A. LL.B. and B.B.A. LL.B. programmes visited the Central Jail, Bengaluru, gaining practical insight into correctional administration and the role of prisons within the criminal justice system.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    25th May, 2023

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Awareness Initiatives on Environmental Conservation and Child Protection Laws 				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									Two awareness programmes were organised on the themes “A Lake for Every Town – A Forest for Every Town” and “Child Sexual Abuse Prevention Laws” as part of a legal awareness initiative.The programme was inaugurated by Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K.R., Principal, RVILS, in the presence of Mr. Arun S., Assistant Professor and Programme Coordinator.The awareness sessions were conducted at Government First Grade College, Jayanagar, and Yediyur Lake, Bengaluru, in collaboration with the District Legal Services Authority, with the objective of educating the public on environmental responsibility and legal protections relating to child safety.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                     09th March, 2023

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					 One-Day Legal Aid Camp and Socio-Legal Survey at Thattaguppe Village

				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The initiative was led by Mr. Arun S., Assistant Professor of Law, and Mr. Shyam Prasad, Assistant Professor of Law, along with 31 student volunteers from the institution.During the programme, the team conducted a survey to identify socio-legal issues faced by residents of the village and provided basic legal guidance and awareness on relevant legal rights and remedies.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
		          
      


            	   
    2022
  
    
      
      
    
  
  
    		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                                                                
                    13th August, 2022

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Educational Visit to District Legal Services Authority and Observation of National Lok Adalat 				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									During the visit, the students of VIII Semester B.A. LL.B. and B.B.A. LL.B. programmes observed the proceedings of the National Lok Adalat, gaining direct exposure to the functioning of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.The students also had the opportunity to interact with Hon’ble Justice Balagopala Krishna (Addl. City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru) who spoke about the importance and role of Lok Adalats in ensuring accessible and speedy justice.

					SCC Online – Legal Research Database				
				
				
				
									SSC Online is one of India’s leading online legal research databases, established in 1996. It provides RVILS students, researchers and legal professionals with access to Supreme Court, High Court and tribunal judgments, statutes and essential legal materials. This platform is an indispensable tool for academic research, moot court preparation and practical legal study, supporting efficient legal research, citation and analysis. 								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Manupatra – Comprehensive Indian Legal Database				
				
				
				
									Manupatra is a leading online legal research platform that provides RVILS students with access to Supreme Court and High Court decisions, tribunal rulings, and central and state legislation. It also covers corporate law, taxation, court rules and parliamentary reports, along with secondary resources such as commentaries, e-books and case analyses. The platform supports efficient legal research, academic study and practical training, making it an essential tool for students, researchers and aspiring legal professionals.

    Legal Services  Clinic
  

				
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) provides students with practical exposure to legal aid and community outreach activities. Under the guidance of faculty members, students participate in initiatives such as legal awareness programmes, legal aid camps, socio-legal surveys and educational visits to courts and legal institutions.The Clinic also collaborates with organisations such as the District Legal Services Authority to conduct programmes that promote legal awareness among the public. These activities help students understand how law operates in real social contexts while encouraging a sense of professional responsibility towards access to justice.								
				
				
				
					        

            
            	    
                

                    
                    Visit Legal Services Clinic 

                                                                                
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					



  
    Aim, Mission  & Objectives
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Aim				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									To provide legal aid through human resource, knowledge resource & infrastructural resource to those who need it the most, purely on a pro- bono basis.								
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Mission				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									The Legal Services Clinic operates in line with the institutional commitment of RVILS towards social responsibility. It seeks to foster sensitivity to community issues, encourage meaningful engagement with society, and promote ethical, value-based legal education through practice and outreach.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Objectives				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
							
											
													
										To promote legal awareness and literacy within the community
									
								
											
													
										To organise legal aid and literacy programmes in collaboration with relevant authorities
									
								
											
													
										To provide free legal assistance to socially and economically disadvantaged sections
									
								
											
													
										To facilitate access to the justice system for those facing practical or financial barriers
									
						
						
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
							
							
											
													
										To develop practical legal skills and professional competence among students
									
								
											
													
										To support initiatives relating to legal policy and institutional frameworks in association with statutory bodies
									
								
											
													
										To encourage a sense of responsibility towards legal and social issues
									
						
						
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Services Provided by the Legal Services Clinic				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Legal Literacy Programmes - Organisation of camps and awareness programmes in association with bodies such as DLSA, KLSA and NALSA, including outreach in villages, institutions and community spaces.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Legal Advice - Free legal consultation available on working days (Monday to Friday: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM – 1:30 PM.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Para-Legal Services - Assistance with drafting applications, documentation, and guidance on procedures relating to government services and legal forums.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Dispute Resolution - Facilitation of amicable settlement through mediation by faculty members, practising advocates and participation in Lok Adalats.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
																														
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Training and Capacity Building - Organisation of seminars, workshops and training programmes to provide practical exposure to student members.

                     25th September 2026

                                    
	                        
        
        				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					Essay Writing Competition				
				
				
				
							
			
						
		
						
				
				
				
									On 25th September 2026, the Legal Services Clinic of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies organized an intra-collegiate Essay Writing Competition in observance of Social Justice Day to foster critical awareness of constitutional rights, systemic inequities, and access to justice. The initiative provided a dynamic academic platform for undergraduate law students to articulate well-researched perspectives on grassroots legal aid, marginalized community empowerment, and judicial reforms. Evaluating entries on analytical rigor, originality, and statutory understanding, the event successfully reinforced the social responsibility inherent in legal education, inspiring future advocates to actively champion equity and pro bono service.
