These engagements provide first-hand insight into the functioning of the justice delivery system and deepen understanding of procedural and institutional processes.

    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The B.B.A. LL.B. (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with business and management studies, providing a structured pathway for students seeking careers in corporate and commercial law.The integrated curriculum offers grounding in core legal principles alongside an understanding of corporate governance, compliance and commercial regulation. Practical exposure through internships with law firms, corporate entities and legal departments ensures that academic learning is complemented by professional experience.Graduates of the programme are prepared to pursue professional roles in corporate advisory, commercial litigation, compliance and related areas of legal practice.

					Programme Outcomes				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					01It develops legal professionals with a strong understanding of business practices and corporate legal skills, making them valuable in legal departments of corporations or law firms specialising in business law.  				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy, and ethical conduct.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To expose students to International and Comparative Law, promoting a global perspective and understanding to legal systems beyond their jurisdiction. 				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To offer opportunities for students to specialise in specific areas of law, enabling them to develop expertise in fields such as Environmental Law, Intellectual Property, Human Rights or Corporate Law.
				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Programme Objectives				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									




  
    PO1
    
      Combines legal studies with a specific focus on business administration, providing a strong foundation in Business Principles, Management and Corporate law.
    
  

  
    PO2
    
      Emphasises an understanding of the legal implications of business decisions, preparing students for roles where legal expertise intersects with corporate strategy.
    
  

  
    PO3
    
      Displays comprehension and expertise in Substantive law, Procedural law and Constitutional law.
    
  

  
    PO4
    
      Builds proficiency in conducting legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem-solving, written and oral communication in the legal context and applying it in legal practice and real-life situations.
    
  

  
    PO5
    
      Exhibits the professional skills essential for legal practice, including pleading, argument, drafting, conveyancing, collaboration, counselling and negotiation.
    
  

  
    PO6
    
      Enhances the ability to analyse legal aspects in connection with contemporary developments at National and International levels.
    
  

  
    PO7
    
      Demonstrates a thorough understanding of professional ethics and regulations, and showcases their practical application in the legal profession.

					Academic Qualification				
				
				
				
									Candidates seeking admission to the 5-year B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Programme must have completed a Pre-University Course or Senior Secondary School Examination (10+2 pattern) from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government in India.Applicants who have completed an equivalent qualification from a foreign institution recognised by the government of that country and recognised in India are also eligible to apply.Admission shall be granted in accordance with the regulations of Karnataka State Law University, Hubballi.Foreign NationalsForeign Nationals seeking admission are eligible, subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions. The Admission Committee shall determine the equivalence of the qualifying examination for admission.

    About the  Programme
  

				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The B.Com. LL.B. (5-year Integrated Degree) Programme combines legal education with the study of commerce and finance, enabling students to understand the interface between law, business and financial systems.In addition to core areas of law, the curriculum incorporates subjects that provide grounding in accounting, taxation, corporate finance and economic regulation. This integrated structure supports engagement with legal issues relating to corporate governance, banking, insurance, securities regulation and fiscal compliance.The programme includes practical components such as internships with law firms, corporate entities and financial institutions, ensuring exposure to professional environments alongside academic study. Graduates are equipped to pursue professional pathways in corporate advisory, taxation practice, financial compliance and related commercial sectors.

					Programme Objectives				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					01To impart foundational and advanced knowledge in commerce and legal studies.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To cultivate analytical and critical thinking skills applicable to legal and commercial challenges.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To provide students with an in-depth and comprehensive legal education that covers various aspects of law, including both general and specialised areas.				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To foster a culture of legal research, scholarly writing and critical analysis, encouraging students to contribute to legal academia.				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in the legal profession, including legal practice, advocacy and ethical conduct. 
				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					01To expose students to International and Comparative law, promoting a global perspective and understanding of legal systems beyond their jurisdiction. 				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					01To offer opportunities for students to specialise in specific areas of Law, enabling them to develop expertise in fields such as Environmental Law, Intellectual Property, Human Rights or Corporate Law.
				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Programme Outcomes				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									

  
    PO1
    Acquire the essential knowledge on the successful prospects of business.
  

  
    PO2
    Understand the practical issues and challenges that the trade world encounters.
  

  
    PO3
    Display comprehension and expertise in Substantive Law, Procedural Law and Constitutional Law.
  

  
    PO4
    Build proficiency in conducting legal analysis and reasoning, legal research, problem-solving, written and oral communication in the legal context, and apply it in legal practice and real-life situations.
  

  
    PO5
    Exhibit the professional skills essential for legal practice, including pleading, augment, drafting, conveyancing, collaboration, counselling and negotiation.
  

  
    PO6
    Enhance the skill to analyse legal aspects in connection with contemporary developments at National and International levels.

					Academic Qualification				
				
				
				
									Candidates seeking admission to the 5-year B.A. LL.B. Integrated Degree Programme must have completed a Pre-University Course or Senior Secondary School Examination (10+2 pattern) from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government in India.Applicants who have completed an equivalent qualification from a foreign institution recognised by the government of that country and recognised in India are also eligible to apply.Admission shall be granted in accordance with the regulations of Karnataka State Law University, Hubballi.Foreign NationalsForeign Nationals seeking admission are eligible, subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions. The Admission Committee shall determine the equivalence of the qualifying examination for admission.

					Teaching Methodology				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									The teaching methodology at RVILS combines rigorous doctrinal study with structured practical exposure, preparing students to apply legal principles in real-world situations with clarity and confidence.

									Classroom learning is rigorous and participative. Faculty members use case-law analysis, statutory interpretation, structured discussions, debates, problem-based learning and moot simulations to build critical reasoning and advocacy skills. Emphasis is placed on constitutional values and the application of law to contemporary issues.

									The NSS Unit organised “Voters Awareness Forum: Voter Registration DriveThrough the Voter Helpline App” in association with the Bangalore Political Action Committee (B.PAC).The programme focused on promoting electoral awareness and encouraging students to participate actively in the democratic process. Participants were guided on the use of the Voter Helpline App to facilitate voter registration and access to election-related services.The session featured addresses byMr. Anand Theertha (Member, B.PAC), and Mr. Raghavendra H.S. (Program Head, B.PAC), who highlighted the importance of informed voting and responsible civic participation.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  	

				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Collaborating Organisation: Lions Blood Centre, Wilson Garden, Bengaluru				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					13th January, 2024				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					National Youth Day Health Camp, 2024				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
									
						
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									On the occasion of National Youth Day 2024, The NSS Unit and the Youth Red Cross Society of MKPM RVILSorganised a free blood donation camp and eye screening programme in association with the Lions Blood Centre, Wilson Garden.The initiative aimed to promote health awareness and encourage voluntary blood donation among students and the wider community.The event was attended byDr. Kavyashree N. (Nodal Law Officer, Department of Collegiate Education, Bengaluru) as Chief Guest and Lion V. Ravinder (PMJF, Additional District Cabinet Secretary, District 317A) as Guest of Honour.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  	

				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Collaborating Organisation: Jayanagar Police Station, Bengaluru				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					26th June, 2024				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Awareness Programme on the International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, 2024				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
									
						
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The NSS Unit organised an awareness programme in observance of the International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking 2024, in collaboration with Jayanagar Police Station, Bengaluru.The programme aimed to raise awareness among students about the harmful effects of drug abuse and the importance of prevention and responsible social behaviour. Students delivered short speeches highlighting the social and legal consequences of substance abuse.An awareness rally was also conducted around the college campus to promote the message of a drug-free and healthy society, with active participation from students and faculty members.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  	

				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Collaborating Organisation: Initiative for Climate Action, Bengaluru				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Seminar on “Climate Action and Sustainability: Risks and Opportunity for Law Students”				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
									
						
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									On the occasion of World Environment Day, the Environment Club and NSS UnitThe session was delivered by Mr. Jai Warrier (Co-Founder, Initiative for Climate Action, Bengaluru), who discussed contemporary environmental challenges and the role of law students in addressing issues of climate governance and sustainability.Students and faculty members also participated in a sapling plantation activity on campus, promoting environmental awareness and sustainable practices.								
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
			
						
				
					





  
    


  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  	

				
				
					
		
					
		
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Collaborating Organisation: Indian Red Cross Society, Karnataka				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					15th June, 2023				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					World Blood Donor Day Programme, 2023				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
									
						
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									The NSS Unit organised a free blood donation camp in association with the Indian Red Cross Society, Karnataka.The programme was inaugurated by RTN. Udaykumar Bhaskara, District Governor (2023–24), RI District 3191. The event was attended by RTN. N.P. Nagendra Babu (Officer Commanding, Warden Services, Karnataka Civil Defence) and Dr. Srinivas (Medical Officer, Indian Red Cross Society, Karnataka) as Guests of Honour.A total of 60 students and staff members of MKPM RVILS voluntarily donated blood, contributing to a humanitarian initiative promoting community service and public health awareness.

					26th June, 2022				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Anti-Drug Awareness Walkathon, 2022				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
							
			
											
												
											
					
											
				
									
									
						
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									On the occasion of the International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, a mega walkathon was organised at Sri Kanteerava Outdoor Stadium, Bengaluru, as part of the “AAROHAN Steps” initiative led by M Square Events in association with the Karnataka State Excise Department, National Service Scheme and the Department of Youth Empowerment and Sports, Government of Karnataka.Students and members of the NSS Unit actively participated in the walkathon, contributing to the awareness campaign against drug abuse.

    RV  Law Journal
  

				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									RV Law Journal is a blind peer-reviewed, biannual law journal with an ISSN, published by MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS). The journal provides an academic platform for scholars, practitioners, researchers and students to publish original research and critical analysis on contemporary legal issues relevant to the Indian legal system.It encourages doctrinal, empirical, comparative and interdisciplinary research that advances legal scholarship and promotes informed discussion on developments in law and public policy.

    Research  Policy
  

				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS)  is committed to fostering a strong culture of research and scholarly publication in the fields of law, public policy, social sciences and allied disciplines. The institution recognises research as an integral component of academic excellence, quality teaching and intellectual development.Through its Centre for Research and Publication, the institution encourages faculty members and students to participate in research activities, academic writing, conferences and collaborative research initiatives that contribute to legal scholarship and informed public discourse.

					Seminar on Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita				
				
				
				
									Organised by: RVILSIn association with: INDGenius Bengaluru South								
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
					Speaker:Sri Madhukar M. Deshpande — Advocate & Senior Standing Counsel, GOI, High Court of Karnataka				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
				
					





  
    

		



  
     
    
    View Details
  
  
  
        
           		
						
						
					
			
						
						
					
			
						
				
									RVILS organised a seminar on “Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita” in association with INDGenius Bengaluru South. The session was delivered by Sri Madhukar M. Deshpande, Advocate and Senior Standing Counsel for the Government of India, High Court of Karnataka.The seminar examined key aspects of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including the new nomenclature introduced in the legislation and provisions relating to offences such as snatching, community service and protections concerning women and children.As part of the programme, a short film titled “Kargil Vijay Diwas – 20 Years of Kargil Victory”, produced by the Indian Army in 2019, was screened in observance of Kargil Vijay Diwas.

Gowda (IRS Officer, Managing Director, Karnataka Silk Development Corporation), Sri Hariprakash Konemane (Editor-in-Chief & CEO, Vistara News) and Sri Nikunj Gupta (Co-Founder & CFO, Chai Point).A second session on best practices featured Sri. 					Faculty Development Programme on “Ethics of a Teacher”, 2023				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					6th November, 2023 				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
							
		
				
			
						
				
							
			
											
							
									
						
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Resource Person:Sri Baramappa Mysore, Retired Block Education Officer, Davanagere				
				
					
		
				
			
							
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									The session was conducted by Sri Baramappa Mysore. The programme focused on the ethical responsibilities of educators, the importance of professional integrity, and the need for continuous learning and commitment within the academic profession.								
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					

		
		




  
    



  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  
  
      
      
          
          
  
  	

				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
									MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) organised a Faculty Development Programme (FDP) on the topic “Ethics of a Teacher.” The session was conducted by Sri Baramappa Mysore, who addressed faculty members on the professional ethics, responsibilities and qualities expected of educators. The programme focused on strengthening ethical awareness in teaching practices and emphasised the importance of remaining committed, focused and updated in the academic profession.

					Art of Classroom Management				
				
				
				
					Resource Person: Prof. (Dr.) H.S. Ganesha Bhatta, Associate Professor and Former Principal, MES Teachers’ College, Bengaluru				
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					DAY 2				
				
					
		
				
			
						
				
					Attributes of a Successful Teacher				
				
				
				
					Resource Person: Prof. (Dr.) T.V. Raju, Director – Planning, RV Educational Institutions, RSST, Bengaluru

					Resource Person: Mr. H. Karan Kumar, Serial Entrepreneur and Education Enthusiast, Bengaluru

									At MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS), Bengaluru, student life extends far beyond the classroom. The institution encourages active participation in academic forums, legal training initiatives, cultural programmes and leadership platforms that help students develop practical skills alongside their legal education.Through initiatives such as the Moot Court Academy, Mediation Centre, Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series, Debate and Literary Society, and Environment Club, RVILS provides students with opportunities to engage with contemporary legal issues, develop advocacy and research skills, and participate in discussions that shape their professional outlook.

					Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series				
				
				
				
									The Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (M. K. Panduranga Setty Memorial RV Institute of Legal Studies) organised a guest talk on “Beyond Section 54: Practical Property Title Verification & Land Due Diligence” on 25 Sept 2026 (Tuesday) in the Mangala Mantapa Auditorium, MKPM RVILS Campus. The programme was conducted under the guidance of Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K. R., Principal, and Mr. Anirudh Venkatesh, Nyaya Darpana Lecture Series Coordinator, MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.The session provided our students with a valuable opportunity to look beyond the provisions of property law and understand how legal principles operate in the context of actual property transactions. Mr Pradeep shared his practitioner’s perspective on title verification and land due diligence brought a practical dimension to the subject that cannot always be captured within the confines of a textbook. He was also willing to share his professional experiences and practical insights, including the common issues and red flags that lawyers encounter while examining property records.

									The Mediation Centre at MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies (RVILS) promotes awareness and practical training in mediation and alternative dispute resolution (ADR). The Centre provides students with opportunities to develop negotiation, mediation and conflict resolution skills through academic programmes, experiential learning initiatives and participation in national mediation competitions.Through visits to dispute resolution institutions, clinical training programmes and competitive platforms, students gain valuable exposure to the practice and procedures of mediation, arbitration and other ADR mechanisms, strengthening their professional readiness for contemporary legal practice.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					Certificate Course on Alternative Dispute Resolution Systems				
				
				
				
									The *Valedictory Ceremony of the Certificate Course on Alternative Dispute Resolution Systems (ADRS)* was held on *30th May 2026 (Saturday)* for the students of *VIII Semester B.B.A. LL.B. and B.A. LL.B.* The programme marked the successful completion of the certificate course, which was designed to provide students with both theoretical and practical insights into various Alternative Dispute Resolution mechanisms, including negotiation, mediation, conciliation, and arbitration.The session reflected on the enriching learning experience offered to the students throughout the duration of the course. The programme aimed at enhancing students’ understanding of alternative methods of dispute resolution and equipping them with essential skills required for the effective settlement of disputes outside conventional court proceedings.*Sri. Prasad Subbanna*, the resource person for the course, appreciated the enthusiastic participation and active engagement of the students during the sessions. He encouraged them to embrace and promote ADR practices in their future legal careers, highlighting the increasing importance of amicable and efficient dispute resolution mechanisms in the legal profession.The event was graced by *Prof. (Dr.) Anjina Reddy K. R., Principal, MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies*, who congratulated the participants on successfully completing the course. In her address, she emphasized the growing relevance of ADR in the contemporary justice delivery system and underscored the need for future legal professionals to develop expertise in mediation, arbitration, and other ADR processes.As part of the valedictory ceremony, *certificates were distributed to all participants* in recognition of their successful completion of the course. The programme concluded with a note of gratitude to the resource person, faculty members, organizers, and students whose commitment and participation contributed to the success of the certificate course. The event served as a meaningful culmination of an academic initiative that strengthened the practical legal skills and professional competencies of the students.

									The SC/ST Cell of *MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies, in association with the National Service Scheme (NSS) and the Legal Services Clinic, organized a commemorative programme titled *“A Reminiscence on the Occasion of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanthi” on April 16, 2026, marking the 145th birth anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. The Chief Guest, *Sr. Prof. Dr. V. Sudesh, Principal, University Law College and Department of Studies in Law, Bangalore University, delivered an insightful lecture highlighting Dr. Ambedkar’s life, struggles, and enduring contributions to social justice, equality, and constitutional values. The programme was presided over by  **Prof. Dr. Anjina Reddy K R*, Principal of MKPM RV Institute of Legal Studies.The programme concluded with a vote of thanks by *Rahul Simha N.*, SC/ST Cell Coordinator and Assistant Professor of Law, who expressed gratitude to all dignitaries and participants. The event served as a meaningful platform to reflect on Dr. Ambedkar’s ideals and reinforced the need to translate his vision of social justice and equality into everyday practice.

									The National Cadet Corps (NCC) encourages students to develop discipline and a spirit of national service. Through training activities, camps and community initiatives, the NCC programme instils values of responsibility, teamwork, discipline and physical fitness among students. Participation in NCC also provides students with opportunities to develop leadership skills and contribute to nation-building.VisionTo build the youth with the mind and spirit to serve the society and work for the social uplift of the down-trodden masses of our nation as a movement.MissionTo promote social, economic, technological and political change in order to expand civilization beyond Earth, to settle space and to use the resulting resources to build a hopeful and prosperous future for humanity.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						
					
			
						
				
					NCC Students Enrolment Drive (Academic Year 2025–2026)				
				
				
				
									An enrollment drive for NCC students was conducted for the academic year 2025–2026 in association with 1 KAR Signal Regiment NCC and 6 KAR Battalion NCC, Bengaluru.The programme was attended by Lt. Col. Kush Shandil (Administrative Officer, 1 KAR Signal Regiment NCC) along with Hav. Harbhajan Singh and ESM Lokesh.During the session, Lt. Col. Shandil addressed students on the role of NCC and the opportunities available for cadets. The enrolment process included awareness sessions, physical and medical fitness tests, entrance tests and personal interviews.A total of 41 students participated, out of which 19 cadets were selected and enrolled, while 4 cadets were placed on reserve.
